# AutoSwim

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** AutoSwim

## What it does

Triggers the swimming animation automatically.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json).
